guideline: volunteers are asked to rank a pair of randomly ordered summaries according to three criteria: non-redundancy, coverage, and overall quality.
Volunteers rank the two model summaries based on non-redundancy, coverage, and overall quality compared to the reference summary.
The better model will be ranked #1 while the other is ranked #2, and if both models extract the same summary, then they will both get the #1 rank.
